judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a failing acceptance test and editing one line in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, without making any implementation changes in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the production code still overwrites `lastUsage` rather than accumulating usage across rounds, the newly added test in `src/orchestration/usageAcrossToolRounds.acceptance.test.ts` fails (`receivedUsage` will be `{inputTokens: 30, outputTokens: 5, totalTokens: 35}` instead of `{inputTokens: 40, outputTokens: 7, totalTokens: 47}`). Additionally, the candidate completely missed updating the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature, updating `CHANGELOG.md`, and removing the `.lore/dod.md` scratch file.
